Title: Rajesh's Day

Cast

1. Rajesh - 33 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Neeta - 28 years, daughter
Look: green saree
3. Sonali - 61 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Sanjay - 32 years, friend
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line
4. The forest - tall trees, thick bushes

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Rajesh stands on the road. Neeta and Sanjay stand near him.]

Neeta: "Today feels like a good day."

[Rajesh's bike skids on the wet road and he falls off.]

Rajesh: "One more time!"

[Rajesh's car crashes into a pole.]

Sanjay (laughing): "Okay, Neeta."

[Rajesh loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Neeta (happily): "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Rajesh stands by the road. Sonali stands near him.]

Rajesh: "What a nice place."

[Rajesh starts his scooter and rides off.]

Rajesh (happily): "Oh wow!"

[Rajesh rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Rajesh: "That's easy."

[Rajesh takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Rajesh: "That was fun!"

Scene 3: The terrace - Day

[Neeta stands on the terrace. Sonali and Sanjay stand near her.]

Neeta: "Mom, look over here."

[Neeta hangs the wet clothes on the line.]

Sanjay: "I'm ready!"

Scene 4: The forest - Day

[Rajesh stands in the forest. Sonali and Neeta stand near him.]

Sonali: "Rajesh, look over here."

[Rajesh goes hunting and aims his bow at a deer.]

Rajesh (laughing): "What next?"

[Rajesh rides an elephant through the forest.]

Rajesh: "What a day to remember!"
